blocks.text: Michael V said “Bubble Gang” is still looking for content creators who possess the traits needed for the long-running gag show, noting that television comedy requires a different kind of discipline. In a round-table interview alongside his cast members EA Guzman, Analyn Barro, Matt Lozano and Diego, Michael V said the show has previously tried tapping content creators as guest performers but has yet to find all the qualities it seeks. “Tinry namin ‘yun eh, before, pero may mga hinahanap kaming traits na hindi namin mahanap sa content creators,” he said, adding that “Bubble Gang” continues to invite different guests in […]...
